files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Features

- **Each document can follow its storage path of Paperless:** turn on *Use the storage path of a document in Paperless* in *3 · Structured archive*, and a document with a storage path goes below the archive folder to the path of its template, as Paperless files it, with the marker `[P123]` and its extension; every other document follows the path template as before. A storage path whose template uses logic of Jinja, another filter, a variable that the path template doesn't know or a custom field that Paperless lacks keeps its documents with the path template, and the report of each run and dry-run, and the preview under the template, name it. So do they for a storage path that the account of the app can't see, by its ID, such as `#9`: share it with the account in Paperless. The preview and a dry-run take the switch before you save, and turning it on or off moves the copies as a new template does: each stays the same file, with its shares. The switch is off by default, so no file moves with the update. With it on, the setup of the account of the app grants View for Users and for Custom Fields as well, which the template of a storage path may use.
- **The path template knows the placeholders of Paperless's own file names:** a `PAPERLESS_FILENAME_FORMAT` or a storage path of Paperless works with fewer changes now. `{{ doc_pk }}` gives the ID in seven digits, such as `0000123`, `{{ original_name }}` the name of the uploaded file, as `{{ original_filename }}` does, and `{{ created_month_name_short }}`, `{{ added_year_short }}`, `{{ added_month_name }}` and `{{ added_month_name_short }}` the parts of the dates, with the names of the months in the language of Nextcloud. A custom field may be written as Paperless writes it, `{{ custom_fields|get_cf_value("Invoice number") }}`, and with a default for a document without a value, `{{ custom_fields|get_cf_value("Invoice number", "none") }}`; a button under the template inserts it. Another filter of Jinja, such as `{{ title|upper }}`, isn't saved, and the settings name it. Every template saved before gives the same paths as before, so no file moves.

### Bug fixes

- **A document with a new file version in Paperless-ngx 3.x gets the content and the file type of that version:** Paperless serves the newest version of a document, while the fields of the document still describe its first file. A born-digital PDF added to a scan, which has no archived version, failed its document in every run with *Paperless did not return archive_checksum*, and its copy kept the old content for good; a version of another type, such as a text for a scanned PDF, got the extension of the first file. Now the copy takes the newest version, its archived version or else its original, with the extension of that file, in the same file in Nextcloud, which keeps its ID, its shares and its versions. A document that you merge into another one as a version counts as missing, and its copy goes as the deletion safety says. Paperless-ngx 2.x works as before.
